models.label: Six-axis robot arm
models.description: Six-axis industrial arm modeled down to its mechanism: servo stacks, harmonic drives, crossed-roller bearings, wrist drive shafts, a rack-and-pinion gripper.

models.label: Induction motor
models.description: Foot-mounted TEFC induction motor: finned frame, end bells, fan cowl and terminal box over a 36-slot stator with coils, a 28-bar cage rotor on a keyed shaft with coupling half, two ball bearings, and a seven-blade fan.
